title: ICON 2024 Toyota Tacoma 1.25-3in Stage 9 Suspension System - Billet (w/ Triple Rate Spring)
body_html:
ICON Vehicle Dynamics 2024-2026 Toyota Tacoma suspension systems are designed with maximum performance and the serious driver in mind. ICON engineers’ primary focus is to increase wheel travel and damping ability, which translates into outstanding vehicle control and ride quality both on- and off-road. This Stage 9 system includes vehicle-specific tuned 2.5 Series coilover shocks featuring CDXS equipped remote reservoirs and ICON-engineered coil springs for superior vehicle “feel” through the range of travel. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. Stage 9 also features ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Dual Speed (CDXS) valves for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDXS controls fluid flow under compression, with independent adjustability of high speed and low speed compression force. 10 discreet detented settings for both low and high-speed adjustment knobs allow separate adjustments for handling response and overall aggressiveness. These coilovers are also height adjustable from 1.25-3” of front lift height over stock, allowing the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. The front differential drop brackets and ICON’s specifically designed coilover lengths maximizes the available front suspension travel and prevent CV bind. Additionally, polyurethane differential mounting bushings replace the soft OE bushings to help limit differential movement under load.

ICON Vehicle Specific (V.S.) 2.5 Aluminum Series shocks are designed and built to give your vehicle outstanding performance off-road and a smooth ride on the street. These shocks are configured specifically for each application in both length and damping tune. Like all ICON'S Shock Absorbers, V.S. 2.5 Aluminum Series shocks are fully rebuildable and re-tunable. The ICON CDE Valve upgrade is included for those desiring an easy way to tune the ride electronically from inside the vehicle. Compression Damping Electronic Valve (CDEV) is an electronically controlled valve that meters the flow of oil to regulate the amount of damping force that is created by the shock when compressed. This infinitely variable valve can react in less than 40ms and has the ability to make extremely precise adjustments for varying terrain. CDEV's hydraulic circuits are also custom tailored per application to create the highest resolution and dynamic range allowable for each specific vehicle. Powered by ICON Intelligent Control and proprietary ICON mobile app, the system uses information from the onboard G-force sensor and Gyroscope to perform calculations based on algorithms and user-defined settings to predict terrain and adjust shock settings via the CDEV accordingly. For piggyback and specific remote reservoir applications, ICON'S unique use of a 6061-billet aluminum manifold a few inches below the top cap of the shock creates an internal Bump Zone that when used creates an additional 20% of damping force. This additional force helps prevent harsh bottom outs and controls the suspension when compressing at high velocity.

K&N charge pipe kits are made of free-flowing, mandrel-bent aluminum tubes designed to replace the restrictive factory intercooler piping on specific turbo charged vehicles and offer a wide range of performance customization options. K&N charge pipes have been engineered to reduce turbo charged air pressure loss as well as dramatically increase air flow from the turbo through the intercooler. The charge pipes are constructed from lightweight aluminum with a durable gunmetal gray powder coated finish. title: DEI Exhaust Wrap EXO Series - 0.5in x 20ft - Tan
body_html: EXO Series exhaust wrap solves the problem of extreme exhaust heat in extreme environments like offroading and powersports. EXO Series exhaust wrap is designed for extreme environment use. Traditional exhaust wraps have not been able to withstand the extreme use that Off-road, Dirt track, Desert and other forms of driving have with exposure to water and dirt. The EXO Series is a dual-layer design, using a combination of hi-temp glass fiber, covered with a 304 grade stainless steel exoskeleton. This unique construction maintains high heat protection while offering superior abrasion and impact protection. Our unique Air Gap Technology keeps direct contact of the glass fiber wrap off the hot surface creating an insulating air barrier. The EXO Series exhaust wrap comes in a special 1.5 in. width, making it easy to install on any type of header, exhaust pipe or exhaust system making it perfect for high impact spot protection. In addition, the stainless steel exoskeleton locks together when overlapped keeping the wrap tight and making installation easy. Delivering outstanding looks and Rugged performance for long term durability, available in Black or Tan in either 1.5 in. x 10ft, 20ft, or 30ft rolls.

title: AWE Tuning 2021+ GMC Suburban/Yukon XL 5.3L 0FG Split Rear Exit Catback - Quad Diamond Blk Tips
body_html: The 0FG Exhaust for the Chevrolet Suburban, Chevrolet Tahoe, and GMC Yukon/Yukon XL is a 3” T304L stainless steel catback configuration featuring a front pipe that begins directly after the factory emissions equipment, paired with a tailored mid muffler and resonator combination for a deep, rich tone. Engineered for both standard and XL wheelbase models, the 0FG delivers refined V8 tone, precision fitment, and signature 4.5” double-walled tips in chrome silver or diamond black. U.S.-sourced .065”-wall T304L stainless steel runs from front to back, CNC mandrel-bent for smooth flow and handcrafted in-house for exacting quality. The straight-through design keeps restriction low while the tailored mid muffler and resonator balance exhaust pulses for a deep, clean soundtrack with the right amount of aggression. The 0FG Exhaust is available as a split rear exit configuration with quad tips for models equipped with bumper cutouts, or a side exit configuration with dual tips for models with flat bumpers.

title: SuperPro Land Rover-Sprg/Up/Bush
body_html: These bushings are often overlooked when upgrading the suspension of a 4WD. Leaf spring bushings stabilize the movement of the rear axle, inferior bushings in this area will cause the solid rear axle to move and impart rear end passive steer to the vehicle. It also causes the vehicle to 'wander' all over the road and be unstable under heavy braking. This can be especially noticeable carrying a load or towing a boat or caravan. The OE rubber style bushings are designed to work at standard height with standard tires and with standard loads. By fitting SuperPro Bushings and upgrading to Greaseable Shackles the rear end of your 4WD will handle just about anything you can throw at it!

Control arm bushings form the vital pivot and link between all core suspension components. SuperPro's 'offset' bushing options introduce additional positive caster into the front end suspension geometry. With a small but significant change the additional caster delivers several benefits: Improved straight-line stability and tracking; your vehicle will track straight and return to center with less driver input. Dynamic camber gain with steering angle “ the more your turn the wheel with additional caster the more both wheels will ˜camber' into the turn putting more of the tire's contact patch on the road as the suspension loads up in the corner and helping to resist the tire ˜rolling over' onto the shoulder and compromising grip. Enhanced steering weight and feel; the small caster change will weight up the steering slightly as you come off-center and the improved cornering grip delivers greater feel for the handling limit through the wheel. The caster offset bushings deliver only benefits with no negative impact on tire wear, comfort or unwanted handling behavior. SuperPro's polyurethane bushings are the culmination of nearly 5 decades of suspension expertise and development in Australia's harshest terrain. Designed with durability as a paramount feature we also bring ride and passenger comfort to the forefront of our development. K&N intakes are designed to dramatically reduce intake restriction as they smooth and straighten air flow. This allows your engine to inhale a larger amount of air than the factory air filter assembly. More air means more usable power and acceleration throughout the engine's RPM range. The 57-3022-2 air intake comes with a K&N high-flow air filter that is mounted to a heat shield that installs into the previous air box space behind the radiator. Air is directed past the mass air sensor through an aerodynamically engineered intake tube into the engine's throttle body for a guaranteed power gain. The tube accommodates the factory air temperature sensor and, for vehicles equipped with an air injection, the air injection hose onto which a vent filter is attached to. The oversized oval tapered air filter can be used for up to 100,000 miles before servicing is needed depending on driving conditions. This air intake is relatively easy to install usually in 90 minutes or less using the existing factory mounting points. The tools needed are a screwdriver, ratchet set, knife and a wrench. K&N 57 Series FIPK's are street legal in all 50 US states and come with K&N's Million Mile Limited Warranty.

ICON Vehicle Dynamics V.S. 2.5 Series remote reservoir front coilover shocks are an incredible upgrade for the front end of the 2005-2023 Toyota Tacoma. These adjustable coilovers allow up to 0-3.5” of lift height adjustability on 2005-2015 models or 0-2.75” of lift height adjustability on 2016-2023 models, allowing the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. ICON’s Vehicle-specific shock length and valving along with the larger 2.5” shock body and increased piston area over stock components yield the maximum travel possible along with superior ride quality and suspension performance both on- and off-road. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. Their extended travel length allows for more wheel travel but also requires the installation of aftermarket front upper control arms. ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Dual Speed (CDXS) valves are included for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDXS controls fluid flow under compression, with independent adjustability of high speed and low speed compression force. 10 discreet detented settings for both low and high-speed adjustment knobs allow separate adjustments for handling response and overall aggressiveness. To better support the weight of additional accessories such as aftermarket front bumpers and winches, these coilovers include ICON engineered coil springs with an increased, 700 lbs/in spring rate, allowing for taller ride heights with increased front end weight. title: Mishimoto 15-20 BMW F8X M3/M4 Performance Auxiliary Radiator
body_html:
The 2015-2020 BMW F8X M3 and M4 rely on auxiliary radiators mounted low in the front corners of the car to keep the S55 in its operating window. Under sustained track use and aggressive street driving, the factory units run out of cooling capacity and heat-soak between runs - and their low position leaves them exposed to road debris and the plastic end tanks prone to cracking under repeated heat cycling. The Mishimoto Performance Auxiliary Radiator replaces the stock unit with a larger, fully reinforced aluminum core engineered to add thermal headroom and survive the conditions that retire the OEM part early.----The core carries 9% more volume and 32% more external tube area than stock, rejecting more heat into the airstream when the engine is working hardest. Strutted tubes reinforce the core against the vibration and impacts that fatigue a low-mounted radiator, while removable stone guard shields the exposed face from debris. Aluminum, TIG-welded end tanks replace the failure-prone factory components, and a robust bracket design fits both the driver and passenger-side locations from a single part.----Direct fit for the 2015-2020 BMW F8X M3 and M4 - installs in the factory auxiliary radiator location with no cutting, fabricating, or adapter work required. Backed by the Mishimoto Lifetime Warranty.

A 63% increase in core volume over the OEM radiator delivers greater surface area and thermal capacity, keeping coolant temperatures stable during back-to-back pulls, spirited street sessions, and weekend track days where the stock radiator starts to fall behind.----Designed as a direct-fit replacement for the 2012-2015 Honda Civic Si, this radiator drops in without cutting, fabricating, or modifications, and works seamlessly with all stock hoses and components without alteration. The included high-pressure radiator cap maintains optimal system pressure from the first drive, extracting the full benefit of the upgraded core. The Mishimoto Magnetic Drain Plug catches ferrous metallic debris before it circulates through the cooling system, protecting your K-series engine internals and extending service life beyond what the factory setup allows.----Don't wait for your stock radiator to crack and leave you sidelined. Whether you daily drive your Civic Si, push it hard on weekend canyon runs, or are building toward a higher-output K-series setup, this aluminum radiator handles the sustained thermal demands your factory unit was never built for. Proactive cooling upgrades protect your engine investment - and this one is built to outlast it. title: MagnaFlow MF/R Series 5in Round 304SS Performance Exhaust Muffler
body_html: The MagnaFlow 17169 MF/R Series 5 in. Round body is a purpose built competition muffler kit engineered to survive and perform in the most demanding high output race environments. Its design and durability have been proven through extensive real world race testing conducted in collaboration with Camburg Engineering and validated under aggressive competition conditions by Camburg Racing. Its straight through perforated core, stainless mesh wrap, and continuous roving high temperature insulation fill form a two stage packing system designed to maintain unrestricted flow under sustained heat and pressure while controlling the distracting NVH that slows drivers down, verified through professional testing by Camburg Racing. Single piece billet 304 stainless steel TIG welded end caps with integral V band flanges deliver uncompromising rigidity, leak proof reliability, and the kind of mechanical stability required for repeated wide open throttle abuse. The 16 gauge 304 stainless steel tubular body features internal expansion capability and 3 in. / 3 in. connections, enabling 17169 to handle extreme exhaust mass flow, shock loading, and high cycle thermal stress without fatigue or performance fade. Fully reversible, it integrates cleanly into diverse layouts where packaging, flow direction, and thermal management are critical. Professional installation is recommended, and users should verify compliance with local noise regulations. For installation, the kit includes keyed flanges for precise orientation and V-band clamps for a secure, repeatable seal. Built from corrosion resistant 304 stainless steel and manufactured using CNC robotic precision welding, the MagnaFlow 17169 MF/R Series is a race proven, competition grade muffler kit engineered with direct input from off-road racing professionals and designed for teams and drivers who demand uncompromising performance.

title: Comp Cams Camshaft Kit, Cs 275Deh
body_html:
Fits Chevrolet GEN 1 Small Blocks including the 262, 265, 267, 283, 302, 305, 307, 327, 350 and 400. Does not fit LT1/LT4, or factory roller Small Blocks built from 1985 and newer. GM gradually added roller camshafts to 305's and 350's from the mid 80's forward. Camaros/Firebirds/Corvettes received the roller cams early, but many trucks and SUV's had flat tappet cams until the mid 90's. Remove the intake or timing cover to confirm whether the block is a factory roller or flat tappet. Does not fit the LS1, LS2, LS3 or any LS-based 4.8, 5.3, 5.7, 6.0 and 6.2. 1955-1957 Chevrolet 265 engines require a groove on the 5th cam journal for oiling. Contact us for more information.

title: ACT 07-18 BMW 3.0L Turbo (N54/N55) Mod-Twin 225 HD Sprung Street
body_html:
T1SS-B01 Mod-Twin 225 HD Sprung Street Kit is designed for high powered AWD street cars. It unites uncompromised pedal feel, durability, engagement quality with very high torque capacity by combining twice the organic friction surfaces with an ultra-durable spring center Mono-Drive hub in a completely modular design. Each diaphragm spring endures an exclusive four-stage heat treating process providing a consistent light pedal feel. Steel-backed Friction Plates with high quality organic friction materials deliver stable friction coefficient, good heat capacity and long clutch life. These Friction Plates uniformly transfer torque to the Mono-Drive sprung hub assembly which extends input shaft life and reduces driveline shock from torsional vibration. This kit includes a CNC-machined and dynamically balanced flywheel, pressure plate cover, diaphragm spring, face, puck-style ceramic friction plates, sprung Mono-Drive hub assembly, floater, patented Monoloc Collar, release bearing, alignment tool and pilot bearing (if needed). Mod-Twin clutches are fully rebuildable and most components can be ordered separately.

title: Yukon Gear Ball Joint Kit for AAM 9.25in Front Differential
body_html:
Superior materials lead to superior performance. When you replace and upgrade your failing OE ball joints with a heavy-duty Yukon unit you get a ball joint built to the highest standards of quality and durability. Its housing is CNC-machined from forged SAE 1045 carbon alloy steel and the ball stud is made from induction heat-treated, hot-forged 4140 chromoly. These ball joints use military-grade acetal bearings because of their advanced anti-friction properties and dimensional stability. Ball joints are only as durable as the protection provided by their rubber boots. Yukon ball joints feature a two-staged approach with a synthetic Neoprene/CR outer boot and an inner seal/pancake boot that safeguard the spherical joint and bucket against gritty road grime, oil, gas, and engine fluids, and extreme temperatures. This kit replaces the upper and lower front ball joints on both sides and includes Grade 8 hardware, castle nuts, c-clips, cotter pins, and zerk fittings.

title: Yuasa YTX20HL Maintenance Free AGM 12-Volt Battery
body_html:
Unleash unrelenting starting power and ultimate dependability with the YTX20HL Maintenance Free AGM 12-Volt Battery. Specially engineered for high-demand powersports applications, this high-output battery cranks out a massive 310 Cold Cranking Amps (CCA) to ensure immediate, punchy engine ignition every time you push the starter button. Yuasa’s specialized radial grid structure and extra internal plates supply up to 30 percent more cranking power than standard AGM batteries, making it the perfect upgrade for large-displacement V-twins, heavy touring motorcycles, ATVs, and personal watercraft that demand maximum electrical muscle.Built with advanced Absorbed Glass Mat (AGM) technology, the YTX20HL captures electrolyte completely inside porous microfiber glass separators to create a fully sealed, leak-proof, and spill-proof unit once activated. This permanently sealed design eliminates the hassle of routine fluid checks and topping off with water while delivering superior resistance against extreme engine vibration and trail shock. Heavy-duty lead-calcium grid construction holds a charge up to three times longer than traditional batteries during offseason storage,

title: Timbren 15-20 Chevrolet Suburban/GMC Yukon XL BES Severe Duty Semi-Metallic Brake Pads - Rear
body_html:
When your truck is at maximum GVWR, your brake pads are your primary defense against the physics of a heavy load. Timbren BES OnyxBite™ Brake Pads are a severe-duty upgrade designed specifically for the 1% of truck owners who actually put their vehicles to work. Unlike standard ceramic pads that prioritize low dust over stopping power, the OnyxBite™ formula uses a high-friction, low-metallic compound. This ensures a firm, responsive pedal and a significantly stronger "bite" the moment you hit the brakes, which is critical for reducing stopping distances when towing a trailer or boat.The OnyxBite™ compound is engineered for thermal stability, resisting the "glazing" that occurs when lesser pads are pushed past their limits. To ensure a premium driving experience, these pads feature multi-layer rubber shims and precision chamfers that dampen harmonic vibration and eliminate the squeal often associated with heavy-duty friction materials. They are fully compliant with 2025 copper-free environmental standards, providing modern performance without compromise. Each set arrives with a complete stainless steel hardware kit to ensure a noise-free, professional installation. By choosing OnyxBite™, you are investing in a brake pad that thrives under the high-torque demands of hauling, backed by Timbren’s 42-month or 42,000-mile warranty for long-term peace of mind.

title: Timbren 2000 Toyota Tundra SES Spacer Kit
body_html:
Popular Timbren SES kits were designed to work on pickup trucks with a standard ride height. But installing a lift kit on your pickup truck will increase the distance between the frame and the rear leaf spring and, therefore, compromise the effectiveness of the Timbren SES helper springs. In other words, your lifted truck is still going to squat even after a Timbren SES rear kit has been installed. That's where an approved Timbren spacer kit can fill the gap. This spacer kit will enable you to haul your gear with confidence even if your lifted Toyota Tacoma or Toyota Tundra has approximately 6.00" - 7.50" of space between the frame and the rear leaf spring. Here's how it works: Each spacer kit comes with two 1 inch and two 1/2 inch spacers along with all the necessary hardware. This handy little kit helps you mix and match the spacers when you add them to the Timbren SES assembly allowing you to achieve your desired ride height. Whether you've got a leveling kit, body lift or full suspension lift, Timbren spacer kits allow you to make effective use of your Timbren SES kit while hauling or towing your gear. How Do I Know If I Need a Spacer Kit? To determine whether you need a spacer kit, measure between the frame and rear leaf spring of the truck when empty. If the gap between frame and axle for your Toyota Tacoma or Toyota Tundra is approximately 6.00" - 7.50" you will need to order a spacer kit.

title: Timbren 2015 Ford F-150 SES Spacer Kit
body_html:
Popular Timbren SES kits were designed to work on pickup trucks with a standard ride height. But installing a lift kit on your pickup truck will increase the distance between the frame and the rear axle and, therefore, compromise the effectiveness of the Timbren SES helper springs. In other words, your lifted truck is still going to squat even after a Timbren SES rear kit has been installed. That's where an approved Timbren spacer kit can fill the gap. This spacer kit will enable you to haul your gear with confidence even if your lifted Ford F250 has approximately 9.00" - 10.50" of space between the frame and the rear axle. Here's how it works: Each spacer kit comes with two 1 inch and two 1/2 inch spacers along with all the necessary hardware. This handy little kit helps you mix and match the spacers when you add them to the Timbren SES assembly allowing you to achieve your desired ride height. Whether you've got a leveling kit, body lift or full suspension lift, Timbren spacer kits allow you to make effective use of your Timbren SES kit while hauling or towing your gear. How Do I Know if I Need a Spacer Kit? To determine whether you need a spacer kit, measure between the frame and rear axle of the truck when empty. If the gap between frame and axle for your Ford F250 is approximately 9.00" - 10.50" you will need to order a spacer kit.

Responsible for anchoring the sway bars and facilitating proper function and body control of your vehicle the OEM rubber bushings are tasked with quite a job and in-turn wear quickly compromising the effectiveness of your sway bar and contributing to a loose, sloppy feeling on the road over time. SuperPro's sway bar mount bushings are designed to fit the OEM designed hardware and mountings - no generic one-size-fits all bushings and cheap universal hardware here - each bushing is designed to integrate into the factory suspension design and function.
